question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The man was enjoyed the view from his terrace.
solution:
The Correct Answer is "**was enjoyed"** which contains a grammatical error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of other options.​

 
 
• **the view** is the correct according to the meaning and spelling.
 
• **From his terrace **specifying the place is also correct according to the meaning and spelling.
 
• **was enjoyed **Here ,"**The Man**" is the doer of the action. When Subject does the action then it should be written in** Active Voice **
 
 
• **​Simple Past :- **Subject + Main Verb (2nd Form) + Object
 
 
 
• **The Man** is correct according to the structure, meaning and spelling.
 
 
 
• **The correct answer will be: **' The man **enjoyed** the view from his terrace
